OpenAI President Outlines AI Cyber Defense and Compute Importance

OpenAI President Greg Brockman has advised companies to implement 10 immediate measures to defend against AI-driven cyber threats. He also described compute as the "new oil" of the AI era, highlighting its increasing significance. Brockman also downplayed recent executive departures from OpenAI, suggesting they are not a major concern.
